manifest.name: reporting
manifest.description: KPI snapshots owned by the reporting bundle (BO-F5-01). One row per metric per period: the material a reporting dashboard reads without touching kernel tables. Dashboards, charts and forecasts (BO-F5-02) read these rows; they never query clienti, pipeline or calendario tables directly.

migrations.name: create_reportings
migrations.sql:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS reportings (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  metric TEXT NOT NULL,
  period TEXT NOT NULL,
  value INTEGER NOT NULL,
  unit TEXT,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
) STRICT;

bootstrap.name: pg_bootstrap_reportings
